@@ -28,9 +30,25 @@ Any feature development is carried out in the form of Fork and then PR on GitHub
 2. Clone: Clone the code repository generated in the first step to your local machine and **create a new branch** for development. During development, please click the **Sync Fork button** in time to synchronize with the `main` branch to prevent code expiration and conflicts.
 3. Submit PR: After development and testing, push the code to the remote branch. On GitHub, go to the **Pull Requests page**, create a new PR, select your code branch as the source branch, and the `modelscope/ms-swift:main` branch as the target branch.
 
-4. Write Description: It is necessary to provide a good feature description in the PR, so that the reviewers know the content of your modification.
+4. Write Description: Fill in the PR template, link the related issue if there is one (e.g. `Fixes #123` for bug fixes, or `Refs #123` for features/RFCs), and describe your changes so that the reviewers know the content of your modification.
 5. Review: We hope that the code to be merged is concise and efficient, so we may raise some questions and discuss them. Please note that any issues raised in the review are aimed at the code itself, not at you personally. Once all issues are discussed and resolved, your code will be approved.
 
+### First-time Contributors
+
+If you are contributing to SWIFT for the first time, please follow this process:
+1. Open an issue first (using the issue templates we provide), describing the problem you have found or the feature you would like to develop.
+2. Open a pull request and link the issue in the PR description (e.g. `Fixes #123`).
+
+This avoids duplicate work and ensures that your contribution can be merged. Pull requests from first-time contributors that do not link an issue may be closed directly.
+
+### AI-Assisted Contributions
+
+We welcome AI-assisted contributions — AI tools can help you write better code, catch issues early, and get familiar with the codebase faster. The quality bar is the same for every PR, no matter how it was produced.
+
+- **You are responsible for every line**: review and understand all changed lines yourself, validate the behavior end-to-end, and run the relevant tests before submitting. You should be able to explain how the change works and why it is correct; maintainers may ask about the details.
+- **Pure agent PRs are not accepted**: do not simply forward a change generated by an agent that you cannot understand or vouch for. Reviewing such changes is costly for maintainers, so these PRs will be rejected.
+- **Avoid one-off "busywork" PRs**: single typo fixes, isolated style cleanups, or "theoretical bugs" without a real usage path are hard to justify under the current review load. Bundle mechanical cleanups into a systematic change, or open an issue to discuss first.
+
 ### Code Standards and Development Approach
 SWIFT has conventional variable naming conventions and development approaches. Please follow these approaches as much as possible during development.
 1. Variable names are separated by underscores, and class names are named with the first letter of each word capitalized.

 5. Review：我们希望合入的代码简洁高效，因此可能会提出一些问题并讨论。请注意，任何review中提出的问题是针对代码本身，而非您个人。在所有问题讨论通过后，您的代码会被通过
 
+### 首次贡献者
+
+如果您是第一次向 SWIFT 提交贡献，请遵循以下流程：
+
+1. 先提交 issue（请使用我们提供的 issue 模板），描述您发现的问题或希望开发的功能
+2. 提交 PR，并在 PR 描述中关联该 issue（例如 `Fixes #123`）
+
+这样可以避免重复工作，也能确保您的贡献可以被合入。首次贡献者提交的、未关联 issue 的 PR 可能会被直接关闭。
+
+### AI 辅助贡献
+
+我们欢迎使用 AI 工具辅助贡献——它们可以帮助您写出更好的代码、更早发现问题、更快熟悉代码库。无论代码如何产生，我们对所有 PR 的质量标准是一致的。
+
+- **您需要对每一行代码负责**：请亲自 review 并理解所有改动，端到端验证行为，并在提交前运行相关测试。您应当能够向 Reviewer 解释改动如何工作、为什么是正确的，维护者可能会就细节提问。
+- **拒绝纯 Agent PR**：请不要把 Agent 生成、自己没有理解也无法担保的改动直接转发给我们。Review 这类改动对维护者成本很高，此类 PR 会被拒绝。
+- **避免一次性的「busywork」PR**：单个 typo 修复、孤立的格式调整、没有真实使用路径的「理论 bug」，在当前 review 负载下很难被受理。机械性的清理请打包成系统性的改动，或先开 issue 讨论。
+
 ### 代码规范和开发方式
 
 SWIFT有约定俗成的变量命名方式和开发方式。在开发中请尽量遵循这些方式。
